metadata.title: Franchise Opportunities
metadata.description: Join our driving school franchise network. Be your own boss with flexible hours, good earning potential, and full support from a trusted brand.

hero.title: Build A Rewarding Business With A Trusted Driving School Brand
hero.lede: Join our driving school franchise network and become part of a growing, respected brand dedicated to providing high-quality driver training across the region.
points: Be your own boss with a flexible work-life balance.
Strong earning potential — work as much or as little as you choose.
The satisfaction of helping people gain an essential life skill.
hero.formDescription: Complete your details and we’ll arrange a call, Zoom, or meeting in person.

opportunities.introLabel: Are you looking for a business opportunity that offers?

items.title: Be Your Own Boss
items.body: Run your business your way, with the backing of a proven brand and support network.

items.title: Flexible Work-Life Balance
items.body: Work the hours you want. Take time off when you need it. Build a schedule around your life.

items.title: Good Earning Potential
items.body: Strong base income with the flexibility to take on more work when you want something extra.

items.title: Real Job Satisfaction
items.body: Help people gain an essential life skill every single day — a genuinely rewarding way to earn.

opportunities.body: Whether you’re an experienced driving instructor or an entrepreneur seeking a proven business model, our franchise programme gives you the tools, support, and training needed to succeed.

items.title: Established Brand & Systems
items.body: Benefit from an established brand, proven operating systems, and a successful business framework designed to help you grow quickly and efficiently.

items.title: Training & Support
items.body: Comprehensive training and support from the GoRodie Driving Instructor of the Year 2026, plus ongoing business support, marketing guidance, operational assistance, and instructor development.

items.title: Pupils & Leads
items.body: Supply of students from day one, backed by lead generation systems, marketing and advertising support, and booking and management tools.

items.title: Flexible Lifestyle
items.body: The freedom of running your own business with the backing of a support network — build a schedule that suits your personal and professional goals.

package.title: What You Will Receive
package.intro: As a franchise partner, you’ll gain access to:
items: Training material and resources for you and your students

whoWeWant.title: Who Makes A Successful Franchisee
whoWeWant.intro: We welcome applications from individuals who are:
items: Interested in building a long-term business
Committed to maintaining high service standards
whoWeWant.cardBody: No previous business ownership experience is necessary. If you have the right attitude and ambition, we’ll provide everything else you need.

financial.title: Financial Opportunity
paragraphs: Our franchise model is designed to offer attractive earning potential while keeping overheads manageable. Whether you’re looking for a full-time income or something to build around your existing commitments, there’s real scope to grow.
Your income will depend on factors such as territory, local demand, and your own business development efforts.
financial.cardBody: Complete the contact form and we will arrange either a call, Zoom or meeting in person — whichever suits you best.

items.q: What is included in the franchise package?
items.a: Our franchise packages include pupil supply, marketing support, training, and business guidance.

items.q: Do I need to be a qualified driving instructor to join the franchise?
items.a: No. Franchises can be offered to a PDI who has passed Part 2 status and completed the 40 hours of mandatory training to be able to deliver driving lessons for financial gain.

items.q: How many pupils can I expect?
items.a: Pupil numbers vary by area and demand, but we work hard to provide a steady flow of enquiries. The larger the area you cover initially, the better the opportunities for provision of students.
Yes. Franchise fees vary depending on the package and level of support provided.

items.q: Can I keep my existing pupils?
items.a: In most cases, yes. Existing pupils can usually remain part of your business arrangement.
Yes. Franchise instructors are self-employed and operate their own business while benefiting from our support and branding.

items.q: What marketing support do you provide?
items.a: We invest in local and online marketing to help generate enquiries and increase visibility for franchise instructors.

items.q: Can I leave the franchise if my circumstances change?
items.a: Yes. Terms and notice periods are outlined in the franchise agreement.

items.q: Do you provide ongoing training and development?
items.a: Yes. We offer ongoing training, workshops, and support to help instructors develop their skills and business.

items.q: How do I apply for a franchise?
items.a: Please contact our team to discuss opportunities in your area and arrange an initial consultation.
